semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Azelis provides specialty chemicals and advanced materials relevant to semiconductor manufacturing, but is primarily a distributor and service provider rather than a direct semiconductor manufacturer.
summary: Azelis (India) Private Limited is a global innovation service provider specializing in specialty chemicals, offering tailored solutions for the semiconductor industry. Their Performance Chemicals division includes high-purity materials and advanced formulations essential for semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Ultra-high purity MBE materials and wafers

regional_presence.India: Azelis supports a wide range of industries in India with advanced materials and local application labs.
